market.question: Will the highest temperature in Chengdu be 23°C on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: Forecasts for Chengdu on Apr 30 indicate a high near 27-28°C, well above the 23°C bucket. Multi-source April climatology supports late-April highs of 25-28°C. Probability the daily high lands precisely in the 23°C bucket is low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Possibility of a major cooldown front not visible in current forecast.
